content.text: The cause is a typo in the value table: the 900 entry is `"DCCCC"` where it should be `"CM"`. That makes `_TABLE` lack `"CM"` and every numeral containing it. I'll fix that one entry.

content.text: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I changed one file, `solution/core.py`: the 900 entry in `_VALS` was `"DCCCC"` instead of `"CM"`. Because of that, `_TABLE` never contained `"CM"` or any numeral using it, so `from_roman` rejected inputs like `"CM"`, `"MCMXCIV"`, and most of the 1–3999 round trip. The fix corrects that single table entry and leaves `from_roman` and the rest of the public API unchanged. I did not touch anything under `tests/`.
